alternatives: Sequential ids encoded in base62: rejected, enumerable and leaks volume
Hash of the URL: rejected, same URL from different users would collide by design
content.rationale: 7 random base62 characters give 62^7 = 3.5e12 codes; per-insert collision probability is n/62^7, so a bounded retry (5) plus the DB unique constraint is sufficient and avoids a central counter. Aliases are validated by regex (3-32 chars) and checked against reserved route names.
content.summary: Base62 short-code generation (CSPRNG) and custom-alias validation with reserved words
